user.title: Divoom Times Gate
user.description: Pick your device (auto-discovered on your network) or type its IP, then enter the LocalToken shown in the Divoom app under Device settings.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Times Gate
reconfigure.description: Update the device's IP address, LocalToken, or refresh interval. The integration reloads with the new settings.

starter.title: Fill the screens
starter.description: Pick what to put on the five screens. Found: {found}. Whatever you pick is written once as ordinary screen configuration, so you can edit any screen afterwards and nothing overwrites it. You can also leave the screens empty and configure them later under Configure.

menu_options.starter_energy: Energy: price, house power, battery, solar and a day-ahead price graph

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate Times Gate
reauth_confirm.description: The Times Gate at {ip_address} rejected the stored LocalToken. This happens after you re-pair the device in the Divoom app. Enter the current LocalToken shown in the Divoom app under Device settings.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the device, or the LocalToken was rejected. Check the IP and token.
error.invalid_auth: The device rejected this LocalToken. Check the value shown in the Divoom app under Device settings.

abort.already_configured: This Times Gate is already configured. Its IP address and token were updated in place.
abort.reauth_successful: Reauthentication successful. The new LocalToken was saved.
abort.wrong_device: The device at this IP is a different Times Gate (MAC mismatch). Add it as a new device instead.

init.title: Times Gate configuration
init.description: Editing preset **{preset}**. Screens: {screens}. Nothing is applied until you choose Save & close.

screen_0.title: Screen 1
screen_0.description: Screen 1 of preset **{preset}**, currently {current}. Give it a single page, or a list of pages that rotate by each page's 'duration'. See the README for the page schema.

screen_1.title: Screen 2
screen_1.description: Screen 2 of preset **{preset}**, currently {current}. Give it a single page, or a list of pages that rotate by each page's 'duration'. See the README for the page schema.

screen_2.title: Screen 3
screen_2.description: Screen 3 of preset **{preset}**, currently {current}. Give it a single page, or a list of pages that rotate by each page's 'duration'. See the README for the page schema.

screen_3.title: Screen 4
screen_3.description: Screen 4 of preset **{preset}**, currently {current}. Give it a single page, or a list of pages that rotate by each page's 'duration'. See the README for the page schema.

screen_4.title: Screen 5
screen_4.description: Screen 5 of preset **{preset}**, currently {current}. Give it a single page, or a list of pages that rotate by each page's 'duration'. See the README for the page schema.

settings.title: Settings & faces
settings.description: Refresh interval; the dashboard base preset (HA overlays its content onto this preset — pick one with static faces, or a blank one, to avoid native faces reloading under the overlay); and favorite faces ({overall: [...], per_screen: [...]} with name + clock_id).

energy.title: Build energy screens
energy.description: Read your Home Assistant energy dashboard and fill five screens with a price panel, a house power panel, a battery panel, a solar panel and a day-ahead price graph. Found: {found}. The screens are written to the preset you name below, which becomes the one you are editing. Existing presets are left alone.

preset.title: Preset
preset.description: A preset is a named set of five screens. Switch to another one, or pick an action to add, copy, rename or delete a preset. Currently editing **{preset}**: {screens}.

data.preset_name: New name (for add, copy and rename)

advanced.title: All presets
advanced.description: Every preset as one mapping of name to a list of five pages. Use this to paste a set of screens in or copy one out. Currently editing **{preset}**.

error.preset_name_required: Give the new preset a name.
error.preset_name_taken: A preset with that name already exists.
error.preset_last: This is the only preset left, so it cannot be deleted.
